facts.summary: Early NET data showed modest tumor response; dose escalation needs FDA alignment · Phase 1/2a · [212Pb]VMT-α-NET in neuroendocrine tumors · not yet approved

evidence.summary: Eight of nine patients had durable control of disease. Six of nine patients had a measurable reduction of tumor volume, one of whom had a confirmed response as defined by RECIST v1.1.
evidence.safety: No dose limiting toxicities (DLTs) were observed among any patients. No grade 4 or 5 treatment emergent adverse events (TEAEs) or serious adverse events (SAEs) were observed.
